task.refused: Nothing changed: the task or its AIs moved on in the meantime.
task.hold.manual: The secretary or an admin paused it. Its AIs stay stopped until one of them resumes it.
task.hold.rounds: The AIs went {n} rounds without a person. Reply in its thread to carry on.
task.hold.preempted: A message jumped the queue. It carries on by itself afterwards.
task.hold.failed: Its AIs stay stopped until an admin resumes it or gives it to another AI.
task.hold.failed.admin: Its AIs stay stopped until you resume it or give it to another AI. The count then starts again.
task.hold.depends.never: Cannot start: a task it waits for was cancelled ({tasks}).
task.hold.reviewer: Ready for review, and nobody is named to do it. The secretary or an admin names a reviewer.
task.hold.conflict: The merge did not go through. The secretary or an admin hands it back to be fixed.
task.cancel.title: Cancel {task} for good?
task.cancel.body: Its AIs stop and its open cards close.
task.cancel.branch: Changes not committed yet are lost; the branch stays.
task.cancel.merging: It has passed review and may be merging right now.
task.cancel.depends: Tasks that wait for it could then never start: {tasks}.
task.assign.same: One AI cannot both do the work and review it.
task.assign.stops: {ai} stops here. Changes it has not committed are lost; its commits carry over.
